text: Saw humpbacks and the glacier calving. Cabin was warm.
Wonderful crew. Wish we had known lunch was not included; the kids were hungry by noon.
Rough water on the way back and two in our group were seasick. Crew handled it well.
The walk from the cruise ship was longer than we expected with a stroller.
Rained the whole time and we still saw otters and puffins. Bring a real rain jacket.
Booked through a third party and the pickup instructions conflicted with the email from the company.
Humpback whales right next to the boat and a glacier at the end. The naturalist knew every bird.
Great trip, but bring your own lunch. Hot drinks only on board, and four hours is long for kids.
We saw orcas, sea otters and a bald eagle. The captain kept us posted on everything over the speaker.
The ride back was choppy and my husband felt queasy for an hour. Wish we had taken something before we left.
Rain all morning and it did not matter. The heated cabin and hot chocolate kept us happy between sightings.
Walked from the cruise ship with a stroller. It took us closer to 20 minutes, not 12. Leave extra time.
Our tour company said there was a pickup at the ship. There was no pickup and we nearly missed the boat.
Calving glacier, puffins, and a crew that clearly loves the bay. Worth every penny.
Lovely cruise. Lunch is not included, which we only found out on board. Pack snacks.
Saw a mother humpback and calf. The crew turned off the engine so we could hear them breathe.
Cold and windy on the outside deck. Dress in layers, more than you think.
Two restrooms on board made it easy with three kids. Warm cabin, big windows, great views of the glacier.
We cancelled 36 hours before because of a family emergency and got no refund. The policy was in the email but we missed it.
Rough water near the mouth of the bay. The crew handed out ginger candy and kept checking on people.
Sea lions on the rocks, otters everywhere, a whale tail at the end. The kids talked about it all night.
Beautiful trip. The meeting point is at the small-boat harbor, not the cruise dock. Read the email twice.
Rained the whole time and we still saw whales. Bring a real rain jacket and waterproof pants.
Best part of our Alaska trip. The glacier was huge and the captain explained how fast it is retreating.
Booked on a third-party site and the voucher listed the wrong departure time. We almost cancelled. The company sorted it out at the dock.
Hot drinks were included, but there is no food for sale on board. We were starving by the end.
Puffins, eagles, porpoises and a calving glacier in one afternoon. Fantastic naturalist.
Seasick most of the way back. The crew was kind, but I wish the website had said the afternoon trip is often rougher.
The walk from the cruise ship was fine for us, but an older relative struggled. A taxi would have been smarter.
Heated cabin, clean restrooms, and the crew made coffee all trip. Saw otters and a humpback.
Foggy morning, so the glacier was hard to see. The crew was honest about it before we left the harbor.
Our kids are 5 and 7 and loved every minute. Glacier, seals, and a whale.
Good cruise. We wished we had known there is no lunch. The kids were hungry by the glacier.
The confirmation from the third-party site and the email from the company gave two different meeting times. Stressful start.
Rain, wind and big smiles. We saw orcas! Bring gloves.
Took the 9:00 trip with a stroller. The harbor ramp is steep at low tide, so plan for that.
A calm, sunny day, whales and a glacier. Perfect.
Worth doing, but it got crowded in the cabin when everyone came in from the cold.
The crew spotted a bear on the shore through binoculars. Lots of otters too.
The boat went out in rough seas and half of the passengers were sick. Not for anyone prone to seasickness.
Plan your day: the cruise is four hours plus check-in. We were late for our train because we had not planned for the walk back.
Hot chocolate, a warm cabin, and a humpback breaching. Even in the drizzle it was magic.
Lunch is on you, so eat before the 9:00 boat or bring something. Wonderful views.
The captain slowed down for every sea otter. Our daughter counted twenty-three.
We could not hear the naturalist over the engine from the back of the cabin. Good trip otherwise.
Booked direct on the website, easy check-in, whales and a glacier.
It rained, the windows fogged up, and we saw very little from inside. Disappointing for the price.
Our 3-year-old could not come because the minimum age is 4. We missed that in the listing. Her grandmother watched her and the rest of us loved it.
Out to the glacier and back with humpbacks, otters and puffins. The crew made it feel personal.
The afternoon wind made the deck too cold for photos. A morning trip might be better.
